title: Balaam and the donkey — unfinished questions
english: Much remains on [[Balaam and his donkey >> Bible:Numbers 22:21-35]]. A timed church sermon cannot weigh every word; we return to what still needs inquiry.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XIII; Balaam donkey CLOSEOUT.
